info.title: subkit engine
info.description: Backend workflow engine. See /docs for the interactive reference and /openapi.json for the raw spec. LLM clients can ground themselves on /llms.txt (index) or /llms-full.txt (full docs in one fetch), per https://llmstxt.org, and on /docs.json (every chapter in English and German as one JSON bundle).

post.summary: Redeem the first-run bootstrap token and materialise tenant + admin
post.description: Consumes the one-time token printed to engine stdout on a fresh install. Checks the LLM key with one live probe call first (provider `mock` passes without a call); a refused key answers 422 `llm_unreachable` and saves nothing. Then creates the tenant, admin user, admin API key, writes the LLM provider settings, and flips the post-bootstrap sentinel. The returned `api_key` is the only time the plaintext key is ever returned.

200.description: Bootstrap completed; admin API key returned

401.description: Token missing, expired, or did not match
